```{r}
#within species trait drivers
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(igraph)


```


```{r}
# =========================================================================
# STEP 1: Filter to Target Species & Remove Underrepresented Groups (n <= 3)
# =========================================================================
target_species <- "ICRA"  # Change to "AABR", "AHYA", etc.

df_spp <- df_master %>%
  filter(toupper(species) == target_species) %>%
  # Filter out missing ED50 or Site metadata
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(K_11))

# Filter out K_3 cluster levels that have 3 or fewer samples within this species
valid_clusters <- df_spp %>%
  count(K_11) %>%
  filter(n > 3) %>%
  pull(K_11)

df_spp_clean <- df_spp %>%
  filter(K_11 %in% valid_clusters)

cat("Processing species:", target_species, "\n")
cat("Retained samples:", nrow(df_spp_clean), "across clusters:", paste(valid_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =========================================================================
# STEP 2: Sort by Means/Medians & Measure Metric Span Across Clusters
# =========================================================================
# Isolate all clean photophysiology metrics for this subset
spp_pp_metrics <- colnames(Alls.cor_clean)

# Calculate Metric Family, Median Span (max median - min median), and Means
metric_spans <- df_spp_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(K_11, all_of(spp_pp_metrics)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-K_11, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Metric, K_11) %>%
  summarise(
    Group_Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Group_Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Span = max(Group_Median) - min(Group_Median),
    Mean_Span   = max(Group_Mean) - min(Group_Mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract Metric Family (e.g., "Connect", "Tau1", "Sigma", "NPQ", "qP", "Ratio")
    Metric_Family = str_extract(Metric, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Median_Span))

# Grab Top 10 broadest-shifting metrics for this species
top10_spans <- head(metric_spans, 10)
cat("\n--- TOP 10 METRICS BY MEDIAN SPAN WITHIN", target_species, "---\n")
print(top10_spans %>% dplyr::select(Metric, Metric_Family, Median_Span))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 3: Paired Correlation Matrix & Top 10 Collinear Metric Clusters
# =========================================================================
# 1. Filter out any metrics that have zero standard deviation in this species
spp_pp_metrics_valid <- spp_pp_metrics[sapply(df_spp_clean[, spp_pp_metrics], function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]

# 2. Compute correlation matrix on valid metrics only
cor_spp <- cor(df_spp_clean[, spp_pp_metrics_valid], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

adj_spp <- abs(cor_spp) > 0.6
diag(adj_spp) <- FALSE
adj_spp[is.na(adj_spp)] <- FALSE

g_spp <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_spp, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
clusters_spp <- components(g_spp)$membership

collinear_clusters_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(clusters_spp),
  Collinear_Cluster_ID = clusters_spp
) %>%
  filter(Metric %in% metric_spans$Metric) %>%
  mutate(Metric_Family = str_extract(Metric, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+"))

cat("\n--- TOP COLLINEAR TRAIT MODULES WITHIN", target_species, "---\n")
print(head(collinear_clusters_df, 10))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 4: Significance Testing with FDR Correction (padj, not Bonferroni)
# =========================================================================
p_val_results <- purrr::map_dfr(top10_spans$Metric, function(trait) {
  form <- as.formula(paste(trait, "~ K_11"))
  fit <- lm(form, data = df_spp_clean)
  p_val <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  data.frame(
    Metric = trait,
    Metric_Family = str_extract(trait, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+"),
    P_Value = p_val
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    P_Adj_FDR = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = P_Adj_FDR < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(P_Adj_FDR)

cat("\n--- WITHIN-SPECIES FDR SIGNIFICANCE TESTING ---\n")
print(p_val_results)
```
```{r}
# Pick the top FDR-significant metric
top_trait <- p_val_results$Metric[1]

ggplot(df_spp_clean, aes(x = as.factor(K_11), y = .data[[top_trait]], fill = as.factor(K_11))) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    title = paste("Within-ICRA Driver:", stringr::str_extract(top_trait, "[^.]+")),
    subtitle = paste("FDR-adjusted p-value =", round(p_val_results$P_Adj_FDR[1], 5)),
    x = "Photophysiological Sub-Cluster (K_11)",
    y = "Standardized Trait Value"
  )
```
